contract: docs/modernization/ui-contract.md: Ukrainian task management UI; primary task creation; responsive accessible workflows; safe state recovery.
scope: Actual built React App in disposable installed Chrome headless contexts with explicitly synthetic intercepted API responses. This is rendered UI evidence, not real API/SQL or Identity-cookie E2E.

checker.name: ECC frontend-design-direction check-evidence.js
checker.output: Evidence record complete; visual correctness still requires rendered inspection.

accessibility.evidence: Both viewport runs used keyboard-only login, labelled input/select/textarea checks, registration aria-invalid/describedby validation, visible solid focus outlines of at least 2px and working skip-to-main navigation. Rendered task/registration control targets, including clickable checkbox labels, met 24px minimum. Measured badge, overdue and error text contrast met 4.5:1. Reduced-motion media query matched, computed animation/transition durations were at most .01 seconds and no running animation remained. These are scoped checks, not a formal WCAG or screen-reader audit.

responsive.evidence: Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 rendered the same long synthetic names and Ukrainian labels. Document scroll width stayed within viewport width; task table and board scrolling stayed in their containers. Visual review confirmed wrapped names, readable forms, stable navigation and centered auth panels. Full-page captures use these CSS viewport sizes and can be taller than the viewport.

loading.evidence: A controlled unresolved task request displayed progress. Releasing it rendered actual fixture rows without replacing the UI with invented content.

empty.evidence: An empty task page explained missing results and provided a working Clear filters action at both viewports.

error.evidence: Synthetic task HTTP 503 showed a safe Ukrainian explanation and correlation identifier; no task rows appeared. Retry fetched and rendered the recovered fixture result.

partial.evidence: Project HTTP 503 left successful dashboard tasks visible and showed an unavailable project section with retry and unknown count instead of a fabricated zero.

success.evidence: The rendered task form submitted through the real frontend transport, converted a Kyiv-local deadline to the expected UTC instant and navigated to the returned synthetic task detail. Keyboard login returned to the dashboard; browser storage stayed empty.

permission.evidence: Synthetic owner invitation HTTP 403 removed cached invitation directory and management controls, refreshed session/team reads and retained the allowed member view with a safe access explanation.

additionalStates.session: Business HTTP 401 redirected to login with preserved returnTo and a visible session-ended banner.
additionalStates.conflict: HTTP 409 preserved unsaved fields, offered current-record review, displayed the refreshed record and retried only after an explicit save with the refreshed version.

limits: API requests are intercepted fixtures; backend authorization, SQL transactions, CSRF validation and Identity cookies are not proven by this run.
Real UI + API + test SQL E2E belongs to roadmap step 28.
Only installed Chrome was run; other browsers and assistive technology were not exercised.
Native datetime input display follows browser/platform formatting; submitted UTC conversion was checked.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop dashboard hierarchy, primary action, overdue text cue and long team/project/task names.
Mobile navigation and long names wrap within the document; dashboard sections stack.
Scoped synthetic task list with four real product state labels, assignee filter and pagination.
Filtered board preserves query and shows current-page status columns plus the editable status control.
One-column task form, deadline, reminders and adequate clickable checkbox labels after the mobile fix.
Conflict notice and review action preserve unsaved form fields.
Available tasks remain visible while the project section reports a failure and offers retry.
Task request held by the controlled fixture displays loading progress.
Empty results explain next actions and retain filter controls.
API outage shows safe error text, a synthetic correlation identifier and retry.
Revoked owner rights remove management controls and private invitation list; member view remains allowed.
Centered sign-in form explains the ended session and offers recovery routes.
Centered registration form links password mismatch feedback to its labelled field.
Keyboard focus makes the skip-to-content link visibly available.
Successful synthetic creation renders the returned task detail and reminder settings.
